title: 450 px narrow PR comment figure for arena allocator RSS drop
what: Arena allocator cuts type_check peak RSS by -275 MB (-40.2%) across 10 runs (all 4 workloads drop ~35-40%)

reader_questions.question: How much peak RSS does the arena allocator save on type_check?
reader_questions.expected: About 275 MB (−40.2%, from ~685 MB down to ~410 MB).

reader_questions.question: Did any of the four compiler workloads regress in memory?
reader_questions.expected: No — all four workloads dropped ~34–40% in peak RSS.
